methods.name: LandslideNet
methods.summary: LandslideNet is a semantic segmentation model based on the YOLOv8 framework, specifically designed for single-temporal high-resolution optical remote sensing images. It incorporates four main improvements: Lightweight Spatial Adaptive Weight Convolution (LSAWC) for local feature extraction, Compound Weight Attention (CWA) for focusing on landslide features, Adaptive-DCN for handling complex shapes, and Dynamic Snake Convolution (DSConv) and Diverse Branch Block (DBB) for feature extraction and fusion.
methods.verbatim: Codes can be obtained from https://github.com/AlchemyRookie/ LandslideNet
